frames.gloss: 照前句做，就会有后句的结果（一…就…）
frames.notes: 祈使表条件、and 后接结果；勿当并列动作读

examples.text: But take a longer view and there is a surprising amount that we can say with considerable assurance.
Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.
Ask anyone newly unemployed what they want and the answer is always: a job.

frames.frame: [表语Adj] is [wh-从句]（表语前置倒装）
frames.gloss: …如何/为何，还很不确定（不清楚）
frames.notes: wh-从句重而后置；还原 It is unclear why…

examples.text: Far less certain, however, is how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions.
Also unclear is why Microsoft has gone it alone.

frames.frame: As so often (is the case), [主句]
frames.gloss: 正如惯常的情形（照例如此）
frames.notes: 话语标记整存整取；勿按 as 从句硬拆

examples.text: As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.
As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn't ease the challenge of line-drawing.

frames.frame: Rather than [V-ing], [主句]（句首取舍前置）
frames.notes: 顺序与常用式相反，先否后肯；易误判哪个动作发生

examples.text: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving “to pursue my goal of running a company.

Rather than concluding that children make parents either happy or miserable, Senior suggests we need to redefine happiness: instead of thinking of it as something that can be measured by moment-to-moment joy, we should consider being happy as a past-tense condition.

frames.related: [do A] rather than [do B]；rather than + V-ing + 祈使句（与其A不如B）

frames.notes: very 作形容词表强调，勿读成副词 very

examples.text: Even though the day-to-day experience of raising kids can be soul-crushingly hard, Senior writes that “the very things that in the moment dampen our moods can later be sources of intense gratification and delight.

Even the very phrase "jobseeker's allowance" is about redefining the unemployed as a "jobseeker" who had no fundamental right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions.

candidates.gloss: 如果当初…，就会…（对过去的假设）
candidates.notes: if 省略+had 提前；考研高频倒装

examples.text: But had Entergy kept its word, that debate would be beside the point.

candidates.related: Should you [V] / Were it not for [X]（倒装同族）

candidates.gloss: 鉴于N本来就是这副样子，…
candidates.notes: 独立主格+what it is 固定死词；表无奈归因

examples.text: Human nature being what it is, most people stick with default settings.

candidates.frame: [说法/谚语] has it that [S V]
candidates.notes: have it that=据说；it 为形式宾语

examples.text: An old saying has it that half of all advertising budgets are wasted - the trouble is, no one knows which half.

candidates.notes: 与 too…to（太…而不能）语义相反，极易读反

examples.text: But in Osborneland, your first instinct is to fall into dependency - permanent dependency if you can get it - supported by a state only too ready to indulge your falsehood.

candidates.gloss: 那就更…了（反倒更好/更容易）
candidates.notes: the+比较级固定搭配；勿按 so much 字面读

examples.text: The development of "cloud computing", meanwhile, has made that exploration so much the easier.

candidates.notes: 表贬低限定；与 nothing less than 方向相反

examples.text: Dare to be different, please don't smoke!" pleads one billboard campaign aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers - teenagers, who desire nothing more than fitting in.

candidates.related: nothing less than [X] / nothing short of [X]

candidates.notes: 否定语境=完全不是；勿按『少于』读

examples.text: It's no surprise that Jennifer Senior's insightful, provocative magazine cover story, “I love My Children, I Hate My Life,” is arousing much chatter - nothing gets people talking like the suggestion that child rearing is anything less than a completely fulfilling, life-enriching experience.

candidates.related: nothing less than [X] / nothing short of [X]

candidates.gloss: 照某人的说法，…（暗含不信）
candidates.notes: 固定插入语；引他人说法后常带反驳

examples.text: No shock there, considering how much work it is to raise a kid without a partner to lean on; yet to hear Sandra and Britney tell it, raising a kid on their “own” (read: with round-the-clock help) is a piece of cake.

examples.text: In a society that so persistently celebrates procreation, is it any wonder that admitting you regret having children is equivalent to admitting you support kitten-killing?

candidates.notes: before 从句表『才』，时间先后易读反

examples.text: It was a year before she became head of a tiny Internet-based commodities exchange.

candidates.gloss: 没有什么比…更能让某人…
candidates.notes: like 表比较而非喜欢；gets sb doing 使动

examples.text: It's no surprise that Jennifer Senior's insightful, provocative magazine cover story, “I love My Children, I Hate My Life,” is arousing much chatter - nothing gets people talking like the suggestion that child rearing is anything less than a completely fulfilling, life-enriching experience.

candidates.notes: 虚拟让步倒装；=whether it is A or B

examples.text: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.

examples.text: Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.

examples.text: But it's interesting to wonder if the images we see every week of stress-free, happiness-enhancing parenthood aren't in some small, subconscious way contributing to our own dissatisfactions with the actual experience, in the same way that a small part of us hoped getting “the Rachel” might make us look just a little bit like Jennifer Aniston.
